about.license: Runs on your own account with Telethon. No telemetry, no hidden automation.
about.summary: A bilingual (English/Farsi) personal Telegram userbot with a voice of its own: automation, reminders, search, text tools and a little warmth.

actions.confirm:
⌁ i can do this: {what}

say `{prefix}yura yes` in the next two minutes, or `{prefix}yura no`.
actions.refused: ⌁ no. money and identity aren't mine to touch, and asking again won't change that.
actions.limited: ⌁ that's enough hands for now — ask me again in a while.
actions.agent_on: ⌁ hands on. i can look things up, remember, translate and set reminders myself now.
actions.agent_off: ⌁ hands off. back to talking only.
actions.card_reminder_note: You'll be reminded in the same chat
actions.card_confirm_window: This question lives for two minutes
owner.added: ⌁ {id} is an owner now. she will know him everywhere, and only he can change her.
owner.unknown: ⌁ i could not find that handle on telegram.

remind.card_note: You'll be reminded in the same chat · {relative}
actions.auto_on: ⌁ small things just happen now. only deleting still asks you first.
actions.auto_off: ⌁ back to the old way: the first use of each tool asks you once.
actions.auto_state: ⌁ asking before small things is {state}. `{prefix}yura auto on` or `{prefix}yura auto off` decides it.
errors.command_disabled: ⌁ {name} is switched off. `{prefix}enable {name}` turns it back on.
errors.cannot_disable: ⌁ {name} is the way back — it stays available.

cmd.disable.description: Switches one command off by name — `fal`, `fight`, anything with no feature behind it.
cmd.enable.description: Switches a command back on. It is never itself switchable off.
